# Ability icon mappings

Source: [Icon Reference Sheet](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/6460); page edited 2025-07-13. Evidence: archived documentation; not independently game-verified.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/6460.md#wiki-6460) before using these values.

* means present in game but unavailable to Workshop; ** means alternate-form icon does not switch with target form; ?? marks a source-reported wrong button.

Ability Icon String accepts a Hero value, not a player form. Source omits buttons that display no icon.

Remote gallery previews are not bundled. Image-only cells retain source alt labels; an absent label does not provide an exact asset name.

Archived 2025-07-13; older ability names remain source labels, not verified current mappings.

Baptiste has an extra source cell 0 with no column header. It is retained as an unlabeled source cell; do not infer a button mapping from it.
